body:
Refs #1040 (non-closing reference; the issue stays open until its own gated flow completes). CI-maintenance candidate prepared under the Checkpoint D offline-prototype authorization. DRAFT — PREPARATION ONLY: installation and rollback remain separately unresolved (the maintenance preflight's kernel-path refusal stands untouched); not queued, not maintenance-labeled, not readiness-labeled.

## Scope (two files, nothing else)

- `.github/workflows/request-full-ci.yml` — bounded same-head retry through the trusted requester.
- `product/test-planner/tests/full-ci-readiness-dispatch.test.mjs` — contract tests: preserved controls + unit tests executing the workflow's actual embedded Python + shell-fragment tests + an integrated harness executing the full run-block body against a stateful mocked transport.

## Behavior (independently reviewed design; implemented and asserted)

- Matcher verbs: `FOUND` (lowest-id success precedence), `EXHAUSTED` (newest attempt id + conclusion + updated_at), `PENDING` (newest UNFINISHED attempt), `NONE`; exact head/ref/PR/bot filters unchanged.
- One common authorization gate before EVERY dispatch POST (NONE included): bounded 3-page pagination with rel="next" completeness for both histories; strict timestamps on every validated record; mandatory requester identity (exact head + pull_request_target event); first-attempt-only requesters; self-postdating; spend-once consumption (ties conservative; all statuses count); response-shape validation per endpoint (arrays vs workflow_runs wrappers).
- Dispatch: `return_run_details: true`; returned run validated (exact checks) then pinned (id + attempt). Transport errors, non-2xx, or missing identity = UNCERTAIN: boundary-filtered discovery only (ids strictly newer than the pre-dispatch boundary), bounded wait, refusal — never retransmission.
- Pin/poll modes in check-product-run: pin validates and reports ATTEMPT (completed failures are never pinned); poll derives terminal states and refuses attempt changes.
- Qualification evidence from the pinned attempt (`/attempts/<n>/jobs`); bound summary records run id + attempt.
- Preserved: live-PR authentication, queue-exclusion guard, Product authentication check, aggregate verification, App-published Trusted merge-queue binding, permissions, environment.

## Commits

- eace33f6 — initial candidate
- efe0f53a — six integrated-review corrections (gate termination, collector wiring + shapes, pin/poll protocol, uncertain transport capture, PENDING unfinished-selection, integrated harness)
- 41b75ced — remove a temporary transport trace

## Local qualification (exact commands)

- `AEROLINK_TEST_PYTHON=<runtime> node --test product/test-planner/tests/full-ci-readiness-dispatch.test.mjs` — 27 tests: 18 passed / 9 skipped / 0 failed. The 9 skipped are the integrated scenarios: they require a POSIX runtime (executed by the ubuntu Product gate); Windows/MSYS path translation breaks their file-boundary semantics (documented).
- Every `product/test-planner/tests/*.test.mjs` (15 files, 143+ tests): 0 failures.
- Workflow YAML parse-validated.

## Remaining limits

- `return_run_details` response shape requires qualification against the workflow's pinned API version at acceptance; the lost-response fallback does not depend on it.
- The integrated scenarios execute in the ubuntu Product gate; their local Windows execution is blocked as described. No live dispatch, label action, queue admission, or HOME change was performed.
- Installation and rollback remain unresolved under the protected-workflow transition contract; merging this draft does not establish an installation route.

## Design provenance

Design, executable prototype (23/23), and this implementation's test plan were independently reviewed in the #1040 Checkpoint D offline-prototype qualification.
